notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l002: Sart is the historical source ethnonym for settled Central Asian people; retained as spoken, not silently equated to a modern nationality.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l003: Primary Yudakhin безбелдек = little bustard; the bird's maternal-flight image retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l007: Казкалдак provisionally treated as the unvoiced consonant variant of primary казгалдак, a kind of wild duck, also in same maternal formula8015:27. Exact variant not separately in consulted headword; broad wild duck, no species-level identification asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l011: Primary тунжур is female goshawk. Maternal epithet for son retained with hen, as in source826 paired bird proverb; not silently masculinized. Болпонум spelling compared болпоң, plump/endearing healthy fullness. Initial ата interjection rendered Ah in this maternal address, not a new father-character.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l019: Source mother's thirty-one years retained, no harmonization with other ages.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l027: Root individually inspected1960Semeteygloss374: Тобо denotes worship/prayer to God. This exact epic lexical aid resolves source тобосунан as prayers, not an emendation to топо/clay or a forced repentance-only reading from general dictionary. Born through the holy sages' prayers retains source miraculous conception formula.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b003:l036: Primary айырмач is child's saddle or fork; here simile for white saddle ridge. Following Ak-Kaiky written as a toponym; no modern location claimed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b004:l002: Primary опсолоң sense2 very/exceedingly, not sense1 recklessly brave or sense3 clumsy; adjective intensifies beauty. Уз denotes skilled craftsperson as well as beautiful, retained skilled in craft.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b004:l003: Source shifts to third person herself fourteen, retained rather than harmonized to mother's first-person narration.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b004:l022: Lake reviving, plane tree budding and birds singing are explicit divinatory signs; not asserted as real forecasting method outside the poem.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0824:b004:l038: Primary кымыздык = bistort, historical botanical designation; no modern species-level identification or consumption advice.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l004: Primary кара курт under курт = karakurt, a venomous widow spider. The exaggerated thumb size is source description, not corrected to ordinary zoological measurements.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l005: Бир топ көл denotes considerable lake water here; broad expanse avoids forcing either one counted lake or several distinct lakes. Surrounding place consistently Keng-Kolchuk.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l011: Twigs as great as plane trees, small birds like snowcocks, snakes six fathoms, and wild asses like third-year colts are source comparisons, retained without zoological rationalization.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l015: Кулан primary wild ass/onager; кунан horse in its third year, not a yearling or necessarily three full years old.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l023: Literal not moving a handspan out of it preserved, the woodland context supplies there; possible emotional inner binding remains a material ambiguity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l036: Primary ар II = нар I, hybrid camel; ардай describes Buurul by camel comparison, not invented noble bearing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l038: Primary баймакта2 exact unsaddling/hobbling example places hobbles above hooves; exact limb action secured, not generic tying up.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b005:l004: Кысыр barren/nonbreeding female livestock; source does not explicitly name species in this line. Following horse fat food context noted but not inserted into this noun.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b005:l009: Primary топур IV = томур, break/heap chunks, exact sugar-like-snow feast example; butter heaps retained, not stomping/noise sense.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b005:l015: Primary амаз = намаз, prayer; source spelling retained without invented proper name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b005:l022: Primary чыбыр hillocks/terrain of little hills; not a plant or rope.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b005:l035: Долу primary fierce/wrathful/shrewish character adjective; fierce preserves the source's charged description of Kanykei, not omitted as merely mother.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b005:l039: Kuleshen's Kul-Tokoi is a provisional toponym; no claim of present-day identification. Tree description continues next page.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b003:l011: Баана attested variant of маанаII, refuge; no invented excuses or excuses-for-hunger reading.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b003:l025: Root individually inspected1960gloss372 exact Кутпа1 north,2Fridaysermon. Directional side-of-tree context secures north, no religious sermon direction invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b003:l027: Milk issuing from tree is explicit epic miracle, retained; tree shifts between plane tree and poplar in source, not homogenized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b003:l036: Source explicitly жуманын Кадыр түнү; Night of Power rendered with Friday possessive retained. Primary кадыр I also quotes жуманын кадыр түнүндө; no calendar date or modern theological reconciliation added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b004:l018: Knife purchased for sixty sheep and forty yearling colts as this source states; dictionary example's sixty camels not substituted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b004:l022: Primary кый I exact кый сүбө = false/lower ribs; сүбөө same head. Specific historical narrative action retained, not invented anatomical emendation. Mother interrupts before injury; source is recalled narrative.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0826:b004:l031: Primary туйгунI1 white goshawk; тунжур female goshawk, ranked below tuygun in falconry. Bird proverb distinguishes departed father and remaining son; literal hen epithet retained despite human boy's sex.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0825:b003:l039: Primary Yudakhin ас- IV explicitly defines аса байла- as tethering a horse with its head drawn up during cooling/rest.
